system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Julia, a young woman in a plain high-necked nightdress and wrapper, pausing at the doorway of Helen's bedroom and glancing back over her shoulder.","action":"Julia has half-turned at the threshold, one hand on the door frame, asking Helen a question; Helen sits on the bed edge in her wrapper, listening.","setting":"Helen's bedroom at Stoke Moran, a rural manor room with a window opening onto the dark lawn, dim lamplight from an oil lamp on a side table.","secondaryElements":"Pale moonless darkness pressing against the window glass, the lawn in shadow beyond, faint hint of the plantation trees in the distance; a candle guttering on a dresser, the door standing ajar toward the corridor.","mood":"Quiet, intimate and faintly uneasy, with restrained suspense and a gothic stillness.","timeOfDay":"Late night, around eleven o'clock.","composition":"Medium shot framed through the doorway, Julia in the foreground near the threshold and Helen seated in the lamplit room beyond, the dark window balancing the warm lamp glow."}
